name: delivery-conductor
description: Cross-platform conductor for OpenSpec + UI UX Pro Max + Superpowers + ECC delivery, with explicit terminal-token approval gates and fail-closed tool blocking on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Route and gate four-layer delivery work
interface.longDescription: Delivery Conductor routes T0-T3 work across OpenSpec, UI UX Pro Max, Superpowers, and ECC on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It uses one Python implementation with native commandWindows hook declarations on Windows. It records phase state and evidence outside model memory, pauses at specification, UI design, plan, and final delivery approval gates, and blocks mutations while a human decision is pending. Approval is terminal-only on every platform: run approve.py in an interactive TTY and enter 批准 <token>; missing TTY fails closed.
